seoDescription: Petrina Salema's practice in Vienna. Homes and hospitality spaces, a handful of projects a year, from the plan through materials, sourcing, and styling.
hook: People usually ask for a nicer room. What they need is a room that shapes their life toward how they want to live.
body: I help people fix the rooms they live in, and the ones guests pay to stay in. I started this practice in Vienna in 2021, after years studying interior design and working in architecture studios. Most projects run one to three months, from the plan through materials, sourcing, and styling. I take on only a handful of projects each year, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.

principles.title: Daily life demands
principles.body: If a room only looks good in photos, then it's not finished. The room has to hold up on ordinary days, including cleaning, storage, and how people actually move. You want to live in a finished space, which can keep up with the demands of your daily life.

principles.title: Projects per year
principles.body: There is only room for a few projects at a time. With this pace, each project gets the careful attention it deserves from the first call to final styling.

principles.title: Home and hospitality
principles.body: Whether you're figuring out your own place, or a place that hosts guests, either way the work is the same. What everyone needs is a place to rest that can also have people over, somewhere quiet to think, that will survive real use.

ctaLede: Start with an Intro Call. Bring the floor plan if you have one. In 30 minutes we will know whether a full project or kick-off meeting is the right next step.
